_comment: Synth runtime MCP server registry. SEPARATE from .mcp.json (which is DEV-ONLY tooling for Claude Code / Copilot). Servers listed here are consumed by Synth's own MCP client bridge (core/mcp_bridge) at runtime. Add/remove entries to give Synth external tool access. Set 'enabled': false to disable without removing.

synth_logs.description: Runtime log analysis MCP server shipped with Synth.

filesystem.description: Local filesystem access for Synth (repo + logs roots). DISABLED: the runtime image (python:3.12-slim) has NO node/npx (node exists only in the Dockerfile 'stage_builder' build stage), so 'npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem' cannot start in-container. Also the paths above are HOST paths, not container paths (/app, /app/logs). For sandboxed file writing, Synth uses the native 'agent_write_file' action in plugins/agent_plugin.py instead (no node dependency). Re-enable only after adding a node runtime to the image AND fixing these paths to container-internal roots.
